jobs.summary: Builds customer-facing web apps on Scale’s platform — secure identity and access, admin consoles and real-time operational views — mostly in React and TypeScript, from design collaboration through testing and release.
notes: Implemented the company’s first shared design system, together with designers
Designs API specifications shared across teams, and a reusable framework for managing application entities with minimal code
Automates engineering practice: linting, strict type checking, Git hooks, conventional commits, automated versioning and release notes
Owns quality and delivery: unit, Storybook, Playwright and API contract tests, plus GitLab CI/CD pipelines that publish releases

jobs.summary: Worked on critical public-facing areas such as Checkout, and subscriber-facing ones such as Email.
notes: Managed a small team of front-end developers
Crafted UIs alongside the UX team and helped evolve Polaris, Shopify’s open-source UI kit
Interviewed many candidates and wrote the pair-programming challenges

jobs.summary: Upgraded the UI/UX of every application with a UI framework — Zurb Foundation, customised to the customers’ needs.
notes: Refactored the UX of every view, updating functionality and Backbone.js usage across the codebase
Designed the build system for embedded devices with low storage and performance limits, alongside their UI/UX

jobs.summary: Led the management and technical aspects of the company alongside another business partner, working with clients from multiple cities in Brazil, as well as abroad.
notes: Built websites, features, apps and updates to products for companies such as RedBull, Singer, Renner, Dzam, Farm, BooBox and many others, using the latest available tech or adapting from the customer’s own codebase

jobs.summary: Took care of responsive, bulletproof front-end development for the company’s apps.

modules for the main application, on the company’s private Java framework
